question:
The chord length of a chord made on an arc of a circle is equal to the radius of the circle. The length of the arc is _______ (in units), if the radius of the circle is 21 units.

(Take pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Chord = Radius ⇒ Central angle θ = 60°.

Arc length = (1/6) × Circumference = (1/6) × 2 × (22/7) × 21.

Arc length = 2 × 22 × (3/6) = 22 units.

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 21 units

Chord length = 21 units

**Formula Used:**

Arc length = (2 × π × r × θ) / 360°

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔOAB, OA = OB = Radius = 21 units.

⇒ Given Chord AB = 21 units.

⇒ Since OA = OB = AB, ΔOAB is an equilateral triangle.

⇒ Therefore, central angle θ = 60°.

⇒ Arc length = (2 × 22/7 × 21 × 60) / 360

⇒ Arc length = (2 × 22 × 3) / 6

⇒ Arc length = 132 / 6 = 22 units.

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Central Angle of a Chord

If the length of a chord is equal to the radius of the circle, the triangle formed by the chord and the radii at its endpoints is equilateral, subtending an angle of 60° at the center.

Arc Length Formula

The length of an arc subtending an angle θ at the center is given by L = (2 × π × r × θ) / 360.

Area of Sector

The area of the sector formed by the same arc is A = (π × r² × θ) / 360.</p
